proposals.title: Shareholder proposal to amend the proxy access bylaw to remove candidate resubmission threshold
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend the proxy access bylaw so proxy access director candidates need not obtain a specific percentage vote to qualify as candidates in future meetings.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote Against the shareholder proposal to amend the proxy access bylaw to remove the candidate resubmission threshold.
